content.content: The write places the document whole: the bytes it is given are the node document's complete contents. It is a replacement, never an append and never a patch in place.
content.rationale: A node is one JSON document (D1c, `kpovwvyw`), so a write that merged into whatever file was already there could leave something that is no longer the document its caller handed over; placing the document whole is what makes the write the document's arrival. The exclude interface appends an entry to a file it does not own whole (`xlowmllo`), which is why the form is decided per interface rather than assumed from the landing rule. How such a write lands is the atomic rule's (`rmmlokop`), shared by every writer; what the write puts there is this node's.
